# MetBench catalog source-of-truth whitelist.
# Per CLAUDE.md §12.4 R1 + v2 charter §3 module B: the catalog has two
# projection paths (MetBench_BLL.Core/SystemMT/Launcher/LegacyCatalogFactory.cs
# + SUT/<sut>/catalog.json), and this file is the meta-fact source for both
# the cardinality and the ID set of MRs / SUTs / equations. Any PR that adds
# (or removes) an MR / SUT / equation MUST update this file in lockstep —
# otherwise the catalog-count fact suite (>= 6 test classes; see
# docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-28-p1-catalog-derived-counts-plan.md §6.1)
# will fail loudly. This file replaces the advisory G7 grep retired by the
# same plan.
#
# Categories (one per line):
#   mr:<mr-id>          — distinct MrCatalogEntry.Mr.Id values
#   sut:<sut-name>      — distinct MrCatalogEntry.Mr.SutName values
#   eq:<equation-key>   — distinct EquationMetadata.EquationKey values
#                          (sourced from SystemMtMetadataCatalog.Equations)
#
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. Entries are sorted
# alphabetically (Ordinal) within each section for stable diffs.
